remarks:
Welcome to this inviting ranch home, offering versatile living space, an oversized attached two-car garage, and a private setting on over one acre. Located on a quiet dead-end road, this property provides the perfect blend of comfort, functionality, and outdoor enjoyment.

The spacious kitchen features a convenient pass-through to the formal dining area, making entertaining and everyday gatherings easy. The expansive living room is filled with natural light from skylights and features a striking stone fireplace that creates a warm focal point. French doors lead directly to the large private rear deck, extending the living space outdoors and creating an exceptional setting for entertaining, relaxing, or enjoying the peaceful surroundings.

The private backyard offers plenty of room for children and pets to play, gardening, recreation, or simply unwinding in nature.

The spacious primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet, while two additional bedrooms and two full baths provide comfortable accommodations for family and guests.

A convenient breezeway/laundry room connects the home to the oversized attached two-car garage, providing the perfect transition space for coming and going. There's room to hang outerwear, kick off shoes, and keep everyday essentials organized.

The walk-out basement provides additional storage and flexible space that could serve as a workshop, hobby area, or shop.

With its quiet location, generous outdoor space, expansive deck, oversized garage, and versatile floor plan, this ranch offers plenty of room to live, entertain, work, and enjoy the outdoors. Come see all that this unique property has to offer!
